heading: Questions that cross boundaries
body: My work investigates aquatic–terrestrial subsidies, wetland and coastal food webs, biodiversity conservation, and contaminants in aquatic ecosystems.

items.title: Aquatic–terrestrial connections
items.description: How emerging aquatic insects and resource subsidies connect freshwater habitats to terrestrial food webs.

items.title: Food webs in a changing world
items.description: How hydroperiod, river management, and climate shape trophic interactions in wetlands and coastal marshes.

items.title: Biodiversity & contaminants
items.description: Using invertebrates and ecological tracers to understand freshwater biodiversity and contaminant exposure.
